captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a heavy-duty steer axle assembly with kingpin stub-axles. It features a dark grey, wide I-beam center beam spanning between two steering knuckle assemblies. Each knuckle pivots on a vertical axis relative to the axle beam ends, and they are linked together by a thin track rod running parallel to the main beam. Cylindrical wheel hubs with integrated disc-brake shapes are mounted on the outer spindle faces, allowing rotational movement.
captions.instruction: Generate a dark grey steer axle assembly with a central I-beam, two steerable steering knuckles connected by a thin track rod, and rotating wheel hub assemblies on each end.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first modeling the central axle beam as an I-beam using box and cylinder primitives. It then models the left and right steering knuckles using boolean operations on boxes and cylinders, connecting them to the main beam via vertical revolute joints. A track rod is defined as a thin cylinder spanning between the steering arms. Finally, wheel hubs are created as concentric cylinders and attached to the knuckles using continuous rotational joints representing the wheel spindles.
